RatioValue.description: A ratio, or the reason it is not defined (SPEC-0007 R3).

not_defined.description:
Why the ratio is not defined, for example "equity is negative (-100)"; null when it is
defined.

value.description:
The ratio, in the unit stated by the field that holds it (decimal fraction, multiple or
days); null when the ratio is not defined.

dscr.description:
CFADS / debt service of each period, multiple, in the order of the schedule; empty when
no debt schedule is given.

llcr.description: (Present value of CFADS + reserve balance) / debt outstanding, multiple.

net_financial_position.description: Net financial position used by the ratios, in currency units (positive for net debt).

pv_cfads.description:
Present value of the CFADS of every period at the calculation date, in currency units;
null when no debt schedule is given.
